t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Bannalan ko no kaddin nad Langagan na id baballan do siak amid killa kikaw owayd simba kikaw. Kaddin nad pangintowan kaungkay edda kaddin wara sadda tat kikawn katussan oway edda kikawn katussan tat kaddin kapobrian oway tat kikawn kayamanan. Warad as-san manama gawas kikaw, eddad tabang ta kahimpan, oway naantay ta salili rin.
